summary.en: Conan and Haibara rescue a kitten from a tree and return him to his owner, Tamotsu Ishigami, the owner of a local café. A woman barges into the café exclaiming she found her boss, Kenzo Kanemaru, dead. Location: Office Kanemaru, Living Room Victim: Kenzo Kanemaru Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Tamotsu Ishigami, Fumie Imaoka, and Chika Murai After Conan and Haibara save the kitten of Tamotsu Ishigami, they go to his shop, Fumie Imaoka, a janitor finds Kenzo Kanemaru dead on his office's living room. Conan, Haibara, Kogoro, and Ishigami enter the office to confirm the Kanemaru's death. The authorities arrive. Conan notices that someone used the vacuum and threw away its contents and also finds the paw of a broken maneki neko.
